model_annotation: The provided image displays two line plots comparing the training rewards of two algorithms, "Llama-On-Policy" and "Llama-LUFFY", across two different training set difficulties: "Easy" and "Hard". Both plots share the same x-axis labeled "Steps", which is linearly scaled from 0 to 500 with tick marks at intervals of 100. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards" and is linearly scaled from 0.0 to 0.4 in the top plot and from 0.0 to 0.2 in the bottom plot. In the top plot, titled "Easy Training Set", the "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" line (solid teal with circular markers) starts near 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.35 by step 500. The "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" line (solid red with circular markers) starts near 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.4 by step 500, remaining consistently above the teal line. In the bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set", the "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" line (solid teal with circular markers) starts near 0.0, rises slightly to about 0.02 by step 100, then declines sharply to near 0.0 by step 200 and remains flat. The "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" line (solid red with circular markers) starts near 0.0, rises steadily to approximately 0.2 by step 500, and exhibits some minor fluctuations around that level.
